title: A Bed by the Window
story: Jonah reached the guesthouse after dark. The owner gave him a key and pointed upstairs. His bed was the lower bunk beside the window. He put his backpack under the bed and filled a bottle in the hall. Another guest was asleep, so Jonah kept his voice low. In the morning he asked about the bus to town. The owner wrote the times on a card.
